question.text: For a Large Value Fund (LVF) for accredited investors under Category III, by when must First Close be declared?

answer.text: Within 12 months from grant of registration OR from filing of PPM, whichever is later
Within 24 months from filing of PPM
Any time before Final Close; no specific deadline

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the amended framework, LVFs must declare First Close within 12 months from the date of grant of registration or the date of PPM filing, whichever is later. The Trap: Standard Cat III funds have different timelines; 24 months is incorrect. LVFs do face a specific deadline. Cross-Exam Context: This aligns with the LVF Guidelines issued via SEBI Circular dated June 24, 2022.
